caption:
Most owners know their ad spend down to the dollar. Almost none know what slow follow-up costs them every month.

The Revenue Calculator fixes that. Four inputs: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and how fast you respond.

It hands back three numbers: revenue per lead, what slow response is costing you monthly, and what a 10% improvement in each system is worth over a year.

Most service businesses take hours to answer a new lead. The ones who respond in minutes close far more of them. Run your own numbers and see where you land.
